title: Report illegal content
description: Tell ReelTale about content you believe is illegal. No account needed.
lead: Use this form to tell us about content on ReelTale that you believe is illegal. You don’t need an account.
inApp: Signed in? You can also report a series, an episode or an AI scene with the Report button next to it.

fields.targetHint: Paste the link (for example reeltale.net/watch/…) or the ID of what you’re reporting.
fields.detailsHint: Explain why you believe it’s illegal, and add anything that helps us find it, such as a time in the video.
fields.contactHint: We need your name and email address to handle a notice. Reports of child sexual abuse can be made anonymously.
fields.contactOptional: For this reason, your name and email address are optional.
fields.name: Your name
fields.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that the information in this notice is accurate and complete.
fields.checkFailed: The security check didn’t load. Reload the page to try again, or email your notice to {{email}}.

targets.ai_scene: A scene of an AI story

reasons.minor_safety: Child sexual abuse, or a risk to a child
reasons.sexual_content: Illegal sexual content, or intimate images shared without consent
reasons.impersonation: A real person shown without their consent, or impersonation
reasons.ai_not_labelled: Made with AI but not labelled

fixFields: Please check the fields marked below.

errors.typeMismatch: The link points to something else. Check what you’re reporting.
errors.targetRequired: Paste a link or an ID.
errors.noId: We couldn’t find an ID in this. Paste a link that starts with reeltale.net/watch/, or the ID itself.
errors.seriesLink: Series page links don’t include the ID we need. Paste the link of one of its episodes, or email the series link to {{email}}.
errors.detailsShort: Please explain in at least 10 characters.
errors.detailsLong: Please keep the explanation under 2,000 characters.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.emailLong: This email address is too long.
errors.goodFaithRequired: Please confirm this statement to send the notice.
errors.turnstile: We couldn’t confirm you’re a person. Please try the check again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many notices were sent from your connection today. Please email {{email}} instead.
errors.unavailable: The form isn’t working right now. Please email your notice to {{email}}.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach ReelTale. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rejected: Something in the form wasn’t accepted. Please check it and try again.
errors.failed: We couldn’t send your notice. Please try again, or email {{email}}.
errors.checkPending: Please wait until the security check is done, then send again.

unavailable.title: The form isn’t available right now
unavailable.body: Please email your notice to us instead. Include a link to the content, why you believe it’s illegal, and your name and email address.

demo: This is the demo: notices from this form aren’t sent anywhere. To report something, please email {{email}}.

done.title: Thank you. We’ve received your notice.
done.body: We review every notice and act on content that breaks the law or our Community guidelines.
done.contact: If you gave your email address, we use it only for this notice.
done.demoBody: In the demo, notices stay on this page. To report something, please email {{email}}.

side.title: What happens next
side.review: We review every notice and act on content that breaks the law or our Community guidelines.
side.privacy: We use your name and email address only to handle this notice. Nothing you type here is kept in your browser.
side.emergency: If someone is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first.
side.email: Prefer email? Send your notice to:
